properties.description:
Current user direction: Iterate directly on the runnable filter mock; generated images were rejected as the iteration medium.

Implemented: a disposable Activity board snapshot containing the actual source, filter-expression syntax ancestry and 31 query field descriptors produced by the existing planning owner. Only actor identities are synthetic. Manual capture command: node Systems/Depth3/HarnessApp/capture-query-composer-mock.ts.

First direct UI increment: Reveal context inside the existing composer opens the actual createQueryComposer call with the original value expression selected. A shared view-toolbar selector exposes the captured enclosing syntax nodes; Back to filter preserves the current draft. Reuses the shared query composer, icon buttons, view toolbar/panel and text editor. Source remains read-only in this pass, and no captured code executes.

Focused validation: all 3 query-composer-mock-ui.spec.ts checks passed, including source/metadata fidelity, navigation to the full source and back without draft loss, autocomplete/catalog actions without network requests, and view-switch retention. Screenshot reviewed at Systems/Depth3/HarnessApp/test-results/query-composer-mock-ui-moc-b2342-nd-keeps-every-action-local/query-composer-mock-context.png. Validation complete for this increment: build.ps1 passed its dependency, model-generation, organisation and engine-boundary stages, then failed its final type gate on three new mock integration errors (nullable panel references and a protected editor update method). Those errors were corrected; npm run check:types then passed across 1162 authored source files with zero violations. All 3 focused browser tests were rerun and passed on the corrected state, and the resulting screenshot was inspected. git diff --check passed. The full build command was not rerun after the narrow type corrections; the full test suite was not run.

Mock-only changes remain uncommitted alongside the previous mock implementation. Exact language and navigation boundaries remain open.
